description: Homebrew tap for seleniumbase-rs, a Rust port of SeleniumBase for browser automation and testing. Its formula sbrs builds the sbrs command-line tool and the sbrs-mcp MCP server from the release source and installs shell completions (bash, zsh, fish, PowerShell), a Fig spec, a usage spec and Warp Workflows.
rules: Install the sbrs CLI and the sbrs-mcp MCP server with Homebrew: brew install mustcodeal/tap/sbrs. The tap is the GitHub repository MustCodeAl/homebrew-tap; its only formula is Formula/sbrs.rb.

The formula builds the release tag named in its url line (currently v0.3.0) from source with Homebrew's rust; there is no prebuilt bottle. Update with brew upgrade sbrs; brew install --HEAD mustcodeal/tap/sbrs builds the main branch.
Two binaries land on PATH: sbrs (the CLI) and sbrs-mcp (the MCP server, built with the mcp-server feature). sbrs --version prints the version and sbrs doctor checks the environment.

To use sbrs-mcp from an MCP client, register command sbrs-mcp with args ["--server", "cdp"] (stdio). --server takes cdp (driverless Chrome), driver or sb (the default). SB_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sets where tools write screenshots and downloads.

Homebrew installs no browser or driver. sbrs drives an installed Chrome, Edge or Firefox and downloads the matching chromedriver, msedgedriver or geckodriver when a session starts; sbrs install fetches one ahead. The cdp server needs no driver.

sbrs completions <shell> prints a script for bash, zsh, fish, elvish or powershell; fig prints a Fig spec and usage a usage (KDL) spec. The formula installs completions for bash, zsh, fish and PowerShell.
Also installed under $(brew --prefix)/share/sbrs: fig/sbrs.ts, usage/sbrs.usage.kdl and warp-workflows/*.yaml. Copy the workflows to ~/.warp/workflows to see them in Warp's command palette.
The Homebrew build enables only the mcp-server feature, so sbrs commander (needs tui) exits with status 2 and a hint. Build from the seleniumbase-rs git repository with --features tui to get it.

To use seleniumbase-rs as a Rust library, depend on the git repository (it is not on crates.io): seleniumbase-rs = { git = "https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs", tag = "v0.3.0" }; it needs Rust 1.99.

This tap holds only the formula, README and LICENSE. How to use sbrs and the library (BaseCase, sb_cdp, importers, tutorials) is documented in https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs (docs/ and README).
